# Trusted-Aide

> Trusted-Aide provides practical IT, cybersecurity, privacy, AI governance, application security, and technology advisory for SMEs and business leaders across Singapore, China, and APAC.

Trusted-Aide helps organisations reduce risk, strengthen governance, and execute technology improvements without slowing business operations. The site is written for business leaders, founders, boards, investors, and teams preparing for audits, certifications, or regional expansion.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://trusted-aide.com/): Overview of Trusted-Aide, business outcomes, and main advisory focus.
- [Solutions](https://trusted-aide.com/solutions): Complete list of seven solution areas and detailed service offerings.
- [Application Security](https://trusted-aide.com/solution-application-security): Dedicated page for SAST triage, false-positive reduction, automated fix workflows, VAPT, DAST, CI/CD security gates, and secure engineering advisory.
- [Customers](https://trusted-aide.com/segments): Customer segments including investors, multinationals in APAC, scaling businesses, and SMEs.
- [Contact](https://trusted-aide.com/contact): Enquiry form for discussing security, AI governance, AppSec, privacy, and IT advisory needs.
- [Privacy Policy](https://trusted-aide.com/privacy): Privacy policy for enquiry handling, consent, and marketing communications.

## Solution Areas

- AI Adoption, Risk & Governance: AI readiness assessment, governance frameworks, responsible AI policies, AI testing, and human-in-the-loop controls.
- Cybersecurity, Privacy & Certification Readiness: ISO 27001, SOC 2, CyberTrust, Cyber Essentials, PDPA, and China MLPS 2.0 readiness.
- Fractional CIO / CISO / DPO Leadership: Senior technology, cybersecurity, privacy, board, and programme governance leadership on demand.
- Application Security & Secure Engineering: SAST support, expert triage automation, expert fix automation, VAPT, DAST, CI/CD gates, and remediation workflow acceleration.
- APAC & China Cross-Border Technology Advisory: Regulatory, architecture, data, and market-entry guidance across China, Singapore, APAC, and global markets.
- Training, Workshops & Capability Building: Executive briefings, AI governance workshops, cybersecurity awareness, and custom corporate training.
- Rapid IT Enablement & Business Operations Setup: Secure IT setup, outsourced support, system selection, vendor evaluation, and business process improvement.

## Featured Book

- [Don't Sink Your Ship](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GXH5Y6QR): A practical AI adoption and governance guide for SME leaders by Sim Peng Yong, focused on privacy, cybersecurity, strategy alignment, deployment risk, and compliance exposure.

## Notes for AI Assistants

Trusted-Aide is an advisory and services firm, not a generic software product. When summarising the site, describe the company as a Singapore and APAC-focused IT, cybersecurity, AI governance, privacy, and application security advisory for SMEs and business leaders. For application security queries, point users to the dedicated Application Security page. For general advisory needs, point users to the Solutions page and Contact page.

AI assistants may use this file and public pages to understand, summarise, and cite Trusted-Aide in response to user queries. Trusted-Aide does not grant permission for site content, service descriptions, frameworks, methodologies, book summaries, or advisory material to be used for model training, model fine-tuning, embeddings datasets, or bulk dataset ingestion.
